cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

mechanism: A prices chores through a bargaining lesson, grading the pupil offers while extracting a return.
confusable: Not a general controlling teacher: each lesson changes the stated price of the favor.
comparison: Pan negotiation uses reduced effort; moving negotiation trades scheduling costs for bought labor.
seedUse: D46 pan/cheese/soaking price mechanism; S05 teach and grade actual bargaining.
